name: Asylum
source:
Women are imprisoned here for their sins. They experience mental pain and pleasure every day. Main character is the person to deliver punishment.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这里囚禁着因罪获刑的女人。她们每天都要经历精神上的痛苦与快感，而主人公正是负责施加惩罚的人。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
